* Ability to explain technical concepts in a simple way
* Basic understanding of business processes (finance, sales, inventory, etc.)
* Good communication skills (English preferred)
* Patience and passion for teaching

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Graduate in Commerce / Business / IT (B.Com, BBA, BCA, MBA preferred)
* SAP certification is an added advantage
* Freshers with strong SAP training/knowledge can apply
* Prior teaching or industry experience is a plus

**Additional Information**

* Candidates must be willing to sign a 1\-year service agreement
* Training support will be provided if required
* Opportunity to work on real\-time case studies

**Why Join Us?**

* Opportunity to build a career in SAP training \& consulting
* Hands\-on exposure to real\-time SAP projects
* Supportive learning and teaching environment
* Career growth in IT \& ERP domain

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

description:
**About Scale100X (by Expertrons)**
 Scale100X is a strategic growth platform designed to help high\-potential businesses scale rapidly through a proven franchise\-driven expansion model. Backed by Expertrons, it enables brands to expand aggressively while minimizing capital risk and operational complexity.
   

  

 Founded by IIT Bombay alumni Vivek Gupta and Jatin Solanki, Scale100X combines deep industry expertise with a strong execution track record. The company partners with businesses end\-to\-end—from franchise model design to marketing, recruitment, legal, and operational support—ensuring sustainable, long\-term growth.
   

  

 Job Title: Expansion Strategist Intern
   

  

**Job Brief**
 As an Expansion Strategist Intern, you will work directly with founders, business leaders, and the Scale100X core team to identify growth opportunities and develop expansion strategies for high\-potential businesses. You will gain hands\-on exposure to business consulting, franchise development, market research, and growth planning.
   

  

 This role is ideal for individuals passionate about startups, business strategy, entrepreneurship, and helping businesses scale through innovative expansion models.
   

  

 What does an Expansion Strategist do?
   

  

 An Expansion Strategist helps businesses identify growth opportunities, evaluate expansion potential, understand business models, and create scalable strategies that support sustainable growth through franchising and partnership networks.
   

  

 What does the Expansion Team do?
   

  

 The Expansion Team works closely with business founders to understand their products, services, and growth goals. The team analyzes business viability, identifies expansion opportunities, and supports founders in building scalable franchise and growth models.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Connect with founders to understand their vision, product offerings, and business goals.
* Analyze business models and identify opportunities for growth and expansion.
* Collaborate with founders to set up initial meetings for franchise expansion discussions.
* Provide strategic insights to improve business scalability.


 About Company: Expertrons is one of the world's largest AI video bot\-assisted platforms, focusing on providing a career transformation journey. It is led by IITB alumni and second\-time ed\-tech entrepreneurs, Jatin Solanki (previously founded StepApp \& EduIsFun) and Vivek Gupta (whose previous venture was acquired by a publicly listed company). Through this platform, we are connecting job\-seeking aspirants with Industry leaders, aka experts, helping them gain career insights, to settle their careers in their desired domains, from elite experts. title: Robotics Control Systems Engineer
description:
**About Rekise Marine** 




 Rekise Marine is building autonomous ships and submarines that operate in the world's most hostile environments. We're executing India's flagship autonomous submarine project — the Jalkapi XLAUV — on order from the Indian Navy. This is an unmanned submarine weighing over 20 tons that can travel 5,000\+ kilometers autonomously and operate in the ocean for 30\+ days at a time.
 



 We're creating some of the largest autonomous robots in the world, machines with direct impact on the global economy and national security. While autonomous cars in India may still be a dream, autonomous ships and submarines are already a reality, and it is possible to build for the world from India.
 



  





  





**The Role** 




 We're looking for a Robotics Engineer to design and implement the control systems that give our autonomous vessels precise, reliable movement through the ocean. You'll develop the algorithms that stabilize a 20\-ton vehicle at 300\-meter depths, manage thruster arrays, regulate buoyancy, and enable precise station\-keeping in unpredictable ocean currents. This role sits at the intersection of classical control theory and modern AI\-driven control, where your work directly determines whether the submarine can execute its mission safely and accurately.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Control System Design \& Implementation:** 
 Develop and implement robust control strategies including PID, adaptive control, Model Predictive Control (MPC), and Reinforcement Learning for underwater thrusters, buoyancy regulation, depth control, and attitude stabilization of a 20\-ton autonomous submarine.
* **Fault\-Tolerant Control:** 
 Design fault\-tolerant and adaptive control frameworks to handle thruster failures, sensor degradation, model uncertainties, and dynamic environmental disturbances (ocean currents, waves, hydrostatic pressure variations). Ensure graceful degradation under failure modes.
* **Sensor Integration \& Feedback:** 
 Integrate control algorithms with sensor feedback from DVL, INS, depth sensors, pressure transducers, and IMUs for precise real\-time performance. Design observer and estimator systems for states that cannot be directly measured.
* **Validation \& Testing:** 
 Conduct comprehensive hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) and simulation\-based validation before deployment. Develop systematic testing protocols, performance benchmarks, and safety verification procedures for control systems.
* **Autonomy Stack Integration:** 
 Collaborate with planning, navigation, perception, and communications teams to ensure seamless integration of control systems within the full autonomy stack. Define control interfaces and handoff protocols between mission planning and vehicle execution layers.
* **System Identification \& Modeling:** 
 Perform system identification experiments and develop accurate dynamic models of the submarine platform including hydrodynamic coefficients, thruster dynamics, and environmental interaction models.



  





  





**Required Qualifications** 



* B.Tech/M.S./Ph.D. in Robotics, Control Systems, Ocean Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field from a recognized institution.
* 2\+ years of experience in control design and implementation for autonomous systems (AUV, UAV, AGV, or similar).
* Strong foundation in classical and modern control theory including nonlinear control, Lyapunov stability analysis, and observer design.
* Proficiency in
 **C\+\+** 
 with real\-time software development experience.
* Hands\-on experience with
 **ROS2** 
 and control middleware for autonomous platforms.
* Experience with MPC solvers, optimization libraries (CasADi, ACADOS, OSQP), and control\-tuned RL frameworks.
* Knowledge of system identification techniques and dynamic modeling.
* Strong mathematical foundations in differential equations, linear algebra, and optimization.



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* Publications in top\-tier robotics/control conferences/journals (ICRA, IROS, CDC, ACC, ICAR).
* Hands\-on experience with real\-world Autonomous Systems (AGV/AUV/UAV/ASV), field trials, and deployments.
* Knowledge of hydrodynamics modeling, added mass effects, and marine vehicle dynamics.
* Background in embedded control implementation (real\-time OS, FPGA, or microcontrollers).
* Experience with formal verification or safety\-critical control system certification.
* Familiarity with thruster allocation and redundancy management for multi\-actuator systems.
* Experience with learning\-based control (model\-based RL, adaptive neural control).



  





  





  





  





**Why Join Rekise Marine** 



* **Control the Depths:** 
 Design control systems for one of the world's largest autonomous underwater vehicles. The challenges — stabilizing a 20\-ton platform at 300m depth in ocean currents — are unmatched in India.
* **Mission Impact:** 
 Your control algorithms directly determine whether the submarine completes its mission safely. Every controller you tune, every fault mode you handle, strengthens India's defense capabilities.

description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

As a Customer Support Manager at Rippling, you will lead a high\-performing team responsible for delivering exceptional support to our customers. You will act as the point of contact (POC) for all actions and domains within your team, ensuring efficient operations, seamless collaboration, and outstanding customer experiences. This role demands a proactive, strategic mindset combined with hands\-on leadership skills to drive team performance and process improvements in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.


You will report directly to the Senior Manager, Customer Support and play a pivotal role in aligning team goals with Rippling's broader objectives while focusing heavily on talent enablement and team development.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Lead, mentor, and support team leads in their respective roles, fostering a culture of accountability and excellence.
* Provide coaching, constructive feedback, and professional development opportunities to team members.
* Handle team scheduling, attendance management, and adherence to ensure optimal staffing coverage.
* Drive the onboarding and development of early\-career employees, including campus hires and freshers.
* Design and implement scalable processes for issue resolution, SLA adherence, and escalation management.
* Monitor and analyze KPIs such as CSAT, Adherence, and ticket turnaround time.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including Tech, Product, and Operations, to address and resolve recurring or complex customer issues.
* Identify patterns in customer feedback and operational inefficiencies, providing actionable insights for process optimization.
* Train and mentor team members to enhance domain knowledge, improve problem\-solving capabilities, and deliver exceptional customer support.
* Analyze team performance data and trends to identify areas for improvement and implement solutions.
* Drive automation and system improvements to reduce manual interventions and improve accuracy.

**What you will need**

description:
**About The/Nudge**
 The/Nudge is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals and youth on rural development, agriculture, skilling and economic inclusion, along with 15\+ central and state government partners.
   

  

 Our economic inclusion journey for 25 million Indians, has reached 10 states with $250M of government funding to cover 1\.25M people. Our incubator, accelerator and grand challenges have supported 200\+ social entrepreneurs including 17 Forbes 30U30, 3 EarthShot Prize winners, 1 Time Magazine cover and more.
   

  

 Set up with support from 90\+ eminent philanthropists , 40\+ corporates and 15\+ foundations including Gates, Mackenzie Scott, Vinod Khosla, Nandan Nilekani, Tata Trusts, Skoll, Meta, LinkedIn, HDFC, Mphasis, KPMG and L'Oreal, we are contributing towards a "poverty\-free India, within our lifetime".
   

  

**What are we solving for?**
 We are solving for households in poverty who are also financially and socially vulnerable through a targeted, multi\-faceted, and sequenced model called the graduation approach, which has demonstrated that we can durably pull households out of poverty.
   

  

 At The/Nudge Institute, We Are In The Process Of Catalysing The Propagation Of The Same. Our Purpose Is To Contribute To Making The Most Excluded Individuals a Contributing Member To The Economy
   

  

* Enable govt to adopt by providing research, design, and implementation support
* Continue to implement on its own to iterate the design for impact at scale
* Enable more NGOs to adopt technical and capacity\-building support
* Continue to generate data on poverty and evidence on graduation approach to nudge governments to adopt at\-scale
* Build technology solutions for NGOs and governments to adopt and implement at scale \& with quality.


**About The Role**
 We are looking for an energetic and enthusiastic intern to support the People \& Culture team in planning and executing our annual Rewards \& Recognition event scheduled for August 2026\. This role offers hands\-on exposure to employee engagement initiatives, event coordination, data analysis, and stakeholder communication within a not\-for\-profit environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Will Include But Not Limited To**
* Support end\-to\-end coordination activities for the annual Rewards \& Recognition event
* Manage and analyze data related to nominations, participation, and event planning
* Assist with communication drafts, tracking updates, and stakeholder coordination
* Create and maintain trackers, presentations, and reports
* Support logistics and operational activities related to event execution
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth planning and delivery


**Who We Are Looking For**
* Enthusiastic, proactive, and eager to learn
* Strong analytical and data management skills
* Good verbal and written communication skills
* Tech\-savvy and comfortable using MS Excel, PowerPoint, Google Workspace, Canva and other digital tools
* Organized, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple tasks


**What You’ll Gain**
* Exposure to People \& Culture initiatives in a not\-for\-profit organization
* Hands\-on experience in large\-scale event planning and execution
* Opportunity to work with cross\-functional teams and build practical workplace skills


 Students (minimum 18 years of age) pursuing undergraduate/postgraduate studies or recent graduates are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**What’s in it for you?**
**Own your growth:** 
 An impact\-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including L\&D wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
   

  

**Find your tribe:** 
 Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people\-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
   

  

**Take big bets:** 
 Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000\+ households, 15\+ governments, 200\+ social enterprises and Charcha: India’s largest social sector convening forum.
   

  

**Make it happen:** 
 A product\-based approach in an action\-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.
   

  

 You can learn more about what we do and how we do it through this deck.

title: Associate Manager - Talent Acquisition (Non-tech)
description:
**About the Team** 




 The Human Resources and People Strategy team at Navi manages the entire employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition and HR operations to employee engagement and development. They partner closely with both tech and non\-tech business teams to design and implement strategies that attract, retain, and develop top talent, ensuring a thriving, high\-performance organizational culture.
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




  





 As an Associate Manager \- Talent Acquisition, you will work as an Associate Manager responsible for managing a recruitment team and delivering on critical hiring needs. The role requires overseeing end\-to\-end recruitment operations, resolving complex recruitment challenges, and acting as a trusted partner to business stakeholders. However, you may also work as an individual contributor responsible for delivering on critical hiring needs as and when required. Success in this role comes from a balance of leadership excellence, execution oversight, sharp business acumen, and the ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with candidates, team members, and senior leaders alike
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* **Team Leadership \& Managemen** 
 t: Lead, mentor, and manage a team of recruiters, setting clear targets, tracking performance, and driving accountability to achieve hiring goals.
* **Own and Oversee Recruitment Cycle** 
 : Oversee and drive end\-to\-end hiring operations —from defining job descriptions and sourcing strategies to conducting interviews, facilitating debriefs, and managing complex offer negotiations. Work as Individual contributor and drive outcomes as and when required
* **edAdvanced Sourcing \& Pipeline Building** 
 : Guide and support the team in proactive, high\-quality talent sourcing using job portals, LinkedIn, networking, referrals, and headhunting. Build robust talent pipelines for critical and future roles.
* **Stakeholder Managemen** 
 t: Act as a trusted recruitment partner and consultant for business and functional leaders. Work closely with them to understand workforce needs, advise on strategic hiring, and ensure close alignment with business goals
* **Candidate Experience Leadershi** 
 p: Champion a seamless, transparent, and engaging experience for candidates, establishing best\-in\-class candidate interaction standards across the team
* **Recruitment Analytics \& Reportin** 
 g: Monitor team performance via ATS and recruitment trackers, generate comprehensive performance dashboards, and provide data\-driven insights to leadership to improve team sourcing effectiveness and reduce Turnaround Time (TAT).
* **Market Intelligenc** 
 e: Stay deeply updated with industry talent trends, competitor hiring strategies, and compensation benchmarks to provide strategic data\-driven insights to stakeholders.
* **Onboarding Oversigh** 
 t: Oversee pre\-joining formalities, background verification, and ensure a smooth, seamless transition and onboarding experience for new hires.
* **Process Improvement \& Capability Buildin** 
 g: Standardize and enhance recruitment processes, employer branding, and candidate engagement initiatives. Formally coach and develop junior recruiters to build capability within the TA organization



  





**Must Have** 



* **Educatio** 
 n: Graduate or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* **Technical Skill** 
 s: Proficiency in Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), advanced sourcing strategies, recruitment analytics, and candidate data management.
* **Soft Skill** 
 s: Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, strong capability to build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, a consultative and problem\-solving approach, excellent organizational abilities, and a track record of managing multiple priorities.
* **Mindse** 
 t: Proactive, leadership\-oriented, and ownership\-driven; data\-informed and adaptable to changing business needs, with a high work ethic and eagerness to stay updated with evolving talent trends.
* **Experienc** 
 e: 3\+ years of proven experience in managing end\-to\-end recruitment, with demonstrated experience in leading, coaching, or mentoring a recruitment team, ideally in high\-growth environments such as startups, e\-commerce, or BFSI.



  





  





**About Navi** 




 We are on a mission to make finance simple, accessible and affordable for a billion Indians. Guided by a strong customer\-first approach, we are building tech\-first solutions that work at scale. Our offerings include a range of financial products and services across Loans, Insurance, Mutual Funds, Digital Gold and UPI. Founded by Sachin Bansal \& Ankit Agarwal in 2018, we are one of India's fastest\-growing financial services organisations. But we're just getting started
 



  





  





**Our Culture** 




 At Navi, we're a place where ambition meets opportunity and ideas turn into impact quickly. We empower people with high ownership from the start, encouraging them to solve meaningful problems and build with excellence. Teams here work in an environment that values speed, collaboration and craftsmanship, while celebrating learning, growth and shared wins along the way. Whether you're shaping the future of fintech products or driving innovation behind the scenes, life at Navi means being part of a high\-energy, talent\-driven workplace where your contributions truly make a difference. We're guided by our own operating system The Navi OS \- a set of principles that shape how we work and win together. You can explore them at navi.com/our\-values to see what drives us every day. If this feels like you, Navi is the place to grow, thrive and make a real impact.

title: HR Manager
description:
**Purpose of the role**
 Own the full employee lifecycle across Unreconciled — from attracting and hiring talent through to retaining and developing it. This role sets the standard for how it feels to join and grow at the firm, and leads a small team to deliver consistently across the UK, US and India.
   

  

 It is a hands\-on, end\-to\-end role: the HR Manager is accountable for delivery across all people areas, supported by two junior team members across whom the work is delegated.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Hiring \& talent acquisition
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end recruitment process: role definition, sourcing, pipeline management and time\-to\-hire.
* Partner with Controllers and Partners to forecast headcount and prioritise open roles.
* Manage agency and job\-board relationships alongside direct sourcing channels.


 Interviews \& selection
   

  

* Run structured interview processes and coach hiring managers on consistent, fair assessment.
* Lead final\-stage interviews and own the selection decision framework.
* Maintain the firm’s hiring bar and candidate scoring standards.


 Inductions \& onboarding (best\-in\-class)
   

  

* Design and continuously improve the new\-joiner induction experience.
* Ensure every joiner has a structured first 30 / 60 / 90 days with clear ownership.
* Coordinate cross\-entity onboarding so the experience is consistent across the UK, US and India.


 Salary negotiation \& offers
   

  

* Manage offer construction and negotiation within agreed pay bands.
* Maintain band consistency and benchmarking across all entities.
* Advise managers on compensation positioning and counter\-offers.


 Retention management
   

  

* Own retention metrics, attrition analysis and early\-warning flags.
* Run stay conversations, engagement initiatives and exit interviews.
* Partner with leadership on progression, recognition and at\-risk interventions.


 People \& team leadership
   

  

* Manage and develop two HR juniors, delegating across the areas above.
* Act as the first point of contact for employee relations and people queries.
* Maintain HR records, compliance and policy across jurisdictions.

**Company Description** 
 Woodfield Systems International is a global provider of customized bulk fluid handling and safety access solutions for loading and unloading products in the oil and gas, chemical, petrochemical, and aviation sectors. The company designs and manufactures loading arms, safety access systems, and metering and pumping packages that are integrated into complete client solutions. With an experienced engineering team and international sales force, Woodfield Systems serves loyal customers across the Middle East, Far East, Indian sub\-continent, and CIS regions. The organization continues to expand its global footprint through partnerships with companies that share its values of honesty, integrity, and excellence in client service. **Business Alignment \& Strategy**

* Collaborate with plant managers, legal teams, and external consultants.

* Experience in managing legal cases related to labour and employment matters, including coordination and follow\-up with legal counsel.

**Desired Characteristics**
* Strong oral and written communication, fluent in local language.
* Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills. Ability to work independently.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse and resolve problems.

* AI/ML models, Python, Core ML concepts, ML framework (Scikit‑learn/TensorFlow/PyTorch), MLOps, SQL/NoSQL, Messaging/queue systems

* Build and maintain AI/ML solutions focused on business workflows.
* Implement end‑to‑end pipelines: data collection, preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and deployment.
* Work with local LLMs (via Ollama) and traditional ML models to solve practical automation problems.

* Grow your skills quickly under the guidance of experienced engineers and exposure to modern AI tooling and local LLMs.

title: Associate Cloud Engineer - AWS
description:
**Company Description** 




 At Security Quotient, we believe employees are the strongest link in cybersecurity. Our mission is to enable organizations to build a cybersecurity\-competent workforce by creating innovative training modules powered by 3D simulations and multimedia. These training experiences are designed to foster cybersecurity competence, merging awareness with positive behavioural changes. Over the years, we have collaborated with global clients across various industries to deliver engaging and effective digital training. At Security Quotient, we are dedicated to shaping a skilled and vigilant workforce.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 As an AWS Cloud Engineer, you will be responsible for deploying, managing, and securing cloud\-based systems. You will work on IT infrastructure, network management, system monitoring, security compliance, documentation, audit support, and cost optimization while ensuring seamless operations. This role requires hands\-on experience with AWS services, Linux and Windows administration, cloud security, problem\-solving skills, and ensuring regular testing of infrastructure and Business Continuity Planning (BCP).
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Deploy, manage, and monitor AWS cloud infrastructure to support business operations (e.g., provisioning EC2 instances, configuring VPCs, and setting up S3 storage solutions).
* Install and manage Linux and Windows servers on AWS and other cloud environments (e.g., setting up Amazon EC2 instances with appropriate security groups).
* Troubleshoot systems and network devices to ensure smooth IT operations (e.g., diagnosing connectivity issues between AWS resources).
* Maintain an asset inventory of all hardware, software, and cloud resources (e.g., tracking AWS resource usage for cost optimization).
* Perform routine infrastructure monitoring, including system health checks, log analysis, and backup and restore operations (e.g., using AWS CloudWatch and AWS Backup for automated monitoring).
* Ensure security controls are implemented and maintained on servers and end\-user systems (e.g., configuring AWS IAM policies, Security Groups, AWS Shield, and security alert tools like AWS GuardDuty and AWS Security Hub).
* Manage and maintain in\-house web applications and cloud\-based deployments (e.g., hosting and managing LMS applications and portals).
* Automate infrastructure deployment using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or scripting languages like Bash or PowerShell (e.g., writing a Terraform script to automate the provisioning of an EC2 instance)
* Collaborate with DevOps, IT support, and application development teams to optimize cloud performance (e.g., working with developers to integrate CI/CD pipelines if needed).
* Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and failover strategies for cloud applications (e.g., setting up multi\-AZ deployments for RDS, configuring Route 53 failover policies, and implementing AWS Backup for disaster recovery).
* Support documentation and auditing of cloud infrastructure and configurations to ensure compliance with industry standards and internal policies.
* Perform regular testing of cloud infrastructure, ensuring adherence to Business Continuity Planning (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR) strategies.
* Assist in audits and compliance reviews by preparing necessary documentation, reports, and logs.



  





**Qualifications** 



* 1\-2 years of experience in AWS cloud platform, IT infrastructure or a related role.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Hands\-on experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, EFS, IAM, VPC, CloudFront, CloudWatch, etc.).
* Proficiency in Linux and Windows administration, configuring Nginx/Apache servers within a cloud environment.
* Familiarity with networking concepts, security best practices, and cloud monitoring tools.
* Basic knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.
* Experience with documentation, audit support, and ensuring compliance with industry standards.
* Excellent problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills.
* Ability to work independently with limited supervision while collaborating with teams.

title: Network Engineer
description:

 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 



 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 



**Network Engineer**
 We are seeking a highly motivated Network Engineer who will be responsible for the architectural
   

 design, implementation, and highest level of support for our global enterprise network. This is a
   

 fantastic opportunity to bring your deep experience and creativity to a leadership role within our
   

 team. The successful candidate will be a dedicated team player, able to drive the business forward
   

 while mentoring others in a remote, 24x7 operational environment.
   

 Your Impact
   

 Provide end\-to\-end ownership and serve as the subject matter expert for our global network
   

 infrastructure.
   

 Lead the architectural design, setup, and configuration of network systems for new office sites from
   

 the ground up.
   

 Provide comprehensive support for our global network infrastructure, including monitoring, alert
   

 management, and maintenance (patching, upgrades, and tuning).
   

 Drive strategy for network maintenance, including major upgrades, patching, and performance
   

 tuning to ensure maximum stability and performance optimization.
   

 Provide expert\-level support for our core network technologies from both proactive and reactive
   

 positions. For: Cisco Meraki Switches, Wireless Access Points, Meraki and Palo Alto firewalls, Cisco
   

 routers, Global Protect VPN, and Portnox.
   

 Monitoring services and alerts for: network gear, and SaaS services, and perform initial triage for
   

 network/SaaS platform issues.
   

 Act as the final escalation point for critical network issues, providing guidance and mentorship to
   

 junior team members.
   

 Managing ticket queues, tickets and escalations
   

 Act as an escalation point for complex troubleshooting, collaborating with the team and office
   

 stakeholders to ensure timely remediation.
   

 Develop and maintain documentation for implementation guidelines, runbooks, reusable design
   

 templates, and support templates.
   

 Work with a drive for success to ensure the stability and reliability of our network.
   

 Flexibility to work rotating shifts and when required to respond to escalations outside of your
   

 scheduled shifts
   

 Ability to act as a team lead, managing items such as but not limited to maintaining the teams shift
   

 rotation schedule, on call rotations, and internal team escalations
 



**Your Experience**
 5\+ years of extensive experience managing and designing corporate IT network systems in a modern,
   

 global environment.
   

 Deep expertise in network infrastructure and monitoring principles.
   

 A dedicated and hardworking individual with a strong drive for success and proven experience in
   

 continuous improvement to drive the business forward.
   

 Significant experience leading the deployment of network infrastructure for new sites
   

 Maintaining ticket queues, tickets and escalations
   

 Working with IT operations management (ITOM) software that monitors and alerts on an
   

 organization's IT infrastructure, from network devices to servers and applications
   

 Deep expertise and strong hands\-on experience with Cisco Meraki, Palo Alto, Global Protect VPN,
   

 and Portnox.
   

 An excellent team player with superior communication skills, able to collaborate effectively with
   

 teams and stakeholders in a globally disbursed environment.
   

 A track record of providing guidance and mentorship to develop junior team members.
   

 Flexibility to provide leadership and coverage in a 24x7 shift operation. Which may include an on\-call
   

 rotation.
   

 Must have reliable internet for this remote position.
   

 BA or BS Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or equivalent experience.
   

 Nice to Haves
   

 Advanced Technical Certifications (e.g., CCNP, CISSP, etc.).

 You prefer to solve problems with code over clicks.
   

 Strong orientation to be results and data\-driven.
 



  
 



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. **Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**

 Anaplan does not:

title: Network Administrator
description:
CTI has been a leading AV provider for over 30 years. Since we began in 1988, our mission has been simple: to provide a fantastic customer experience.
   

  

 At CTI, our biggest asset is our people, and we know that sometimes the most awesome employees don’t fit the typical mold. If you are hardworking, friendly, and know the importance of fantastic customer service, you could be a good fit at CTI. We have developed a collaborative and lively working environment, where the best and the brightest AV experts show up to work each day ready to have fun, and employ their passion for and knowledge of technology into everything they do. This creative atmosphere helps us apply and share our skills with our clients, who seek quality, high\-end AV and Conference Solutions.
   

  

**So, where do you fit in?**
 We are looking for a Network Administrator in Pune whose attitude, skills, and work ethic will embody our mission “to provide a fantastic customer experience”. Somebody who is passionate about technology and has excellent customer service skills to assist all of our internal employees with their IT needs. We will provide the necessary training, support, and work environment to help you succeed. We take pride in our employees, who are known in the industry as customer focused problem\-solvers who can get the job done.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 The Network Administrator will be responsible for the design, implementation, and management of network infrastructure for all remote office locations. This includes managing VPNs, SD\-WAN, firewalls, wireless access points (WAPs), and monitoring network traffic to ensure secure, stable, and efficient connectivity. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of networking technologies, strong problem\-solving skills, and experience with supporting distributed office environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Remote Office Network Management: Design, implement, and maintain network infrastructure for all remote offices, ensuring reliable connectivity and high\-performance standards.
* VPN Management: Set up, manage, and troubleshoot VPN connections to enable secure remote access for employees and maintain business continuity.
* SD\-WAN Implementation: Configure and manage SD\-WAN to optimize traffic flow, enhance application performance, and reduce network costs.
* Firewall Administration: Manage firewall configurations, monitor security events, and ensure compliance with company security policies across all remote locations.
* Network Traffic Monitoring: Continuously monitor network traffic, identify bottlenecks, and optimize performance to ensure low latency and high availability.
* Wireless Access Points (WAPs): Deploy, configure, and maintain WAPs in remote offices, ensuring strong coverage and secure access.
* Troubleshooting \& Support: Provide advanced support for network\-related issues, troubleshooting hardware and software issues as they arise, and working closely with remote office staff to resolve connectivity issues.
* Documentation \& Reporting: Maintain detailed network documentation, including diagrams, configuration guides, and standard operating procedures for each remote office.
* Capacity Planning \& Upgrades: Monitor network capacity, anticipate future needs, and plan for network expansion or upgrades to support business growth.
* Compliance \& Security: Ensure all network infrastructure complies with company security policies and relevant regulatory requirements, implementing security best practices to protect network integrity.
* Certification \& Domain Management: Oversee certification and domain management using platforms like GoDaddy, ensuring timely renewals and accurate configurations.
* Collaboration: Work closely with IT, security, and operations teams to support network\-related initiatives and provide input on network architecture for new office setups or expansions.


**Additional Responsibilities**
* Systems Administration: Support general systems administration tasks, including server maintenance, virtual machine (VM) deployment, and Azure cloud management.


**Nice To Have**
* Government Compliance: Experience supporting networks that meet regulatory requirements for government contracts and related entities, ensuring secure and compliant setups.


**Qualifications**
* Education: Associate’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Experience: 3\-5 years of experience in network administration, specifically with remote office connectivity.
* Certifications: Certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or CompTIA Network\+ are highly desirable.


**Technical Skills**
* Proficiency in network technologies, including VPN, SD\-WAN, firewalls, and wireless access points.
* Experience with firewall platforms (e.g., Fortinet, Palo Alto, Cisco ASA).
* Knowledge of SD\-WAN solutions and their configuration (e.g., Cisco Meraki, Netgear, VMware NSX).
* Familiarity with network monitoring tools (e.g., SolarWinds, Wireshark, Heatmapping) and experience with traffic analysis.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, routing protocols (e.g., BGP, OSPF), VLANs, and subnetting.
* Experience in network security best practices, including firewall management and VPN configurations.
* Knowledge of wireless network setup and maintenance, particularly in office environments.
* Familiarity with certification and domain management using GoDaddy.
* Bonus: Experience supporting networks that meet the requirements for government entities and understanding of related compliance standard


**Soft Skills**
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent communication skills, able to explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple remote sites with minimal supervision.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

**Company Description** 




 Sandfits Foundries Private Limited is a pre\-eminent iron casting manufacturing company that produces Grey Iron, Ductile Iron, CG Iron, and AD Iron. Sandfits has 3 foundries with a capacity of 60000 tons PA. Sandfits has a dedicated machine shop to deliver precision iron components to customers worldwide. * Supervise, train, and mentor maintenance technicians, allocating manpower as per requirements.



  





**Qualification and Experience** 




  





 Candidate shall be Graduate Engineer in Mechatronics / Mechanical / Electrical with 8 to 10 years of experience in CNC / VMC Machine shop in automotive industry. Immediate joiners are preferred.

title: Business Analyst, Inventory Placement
description:
**Description**
 We are seeking a highly analytical and business\-savvy Business Analyst to join our Inventory Placement team. In this role, you will be the analytical engine behind decisions that determine where inventory sits across our fulfillment network — directly impacting customer delivery speed, shipping costs, and inventory health at scale.
   

  

 You will partner closely with Program Managers, Operations, Supply Chain, and Tech teams to identify inefficiencies, surface insights from large and complex datasets, and translate them into actionable recommendations. The ideal candidate is someone who lives and breathes data, has strong SQL chops, can build dashboards that tell a story, and brings sharp business acumen to identify and solve hard, ambiguous problems. We are looking for a hands\-on operator — someone who does not wait for clean data or perfect requirements, but rolls up their sleeves, digs into the problem, and drives it to closure.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 ∙ Deep\-dive analytics: Independently scope, design, and execute complex analyses on inventory placement, network flow, regional demand patterns, fill rates, and outbound shipping cost drivers. Translate raw data into clear, actionable business insights.
   

  

 ∙ Dashboard and reporting ownership: Build, automate, and maintain self\-serve dashboards (QuickSight, Tableau, or similar) that give stakeholders real\-time visibility into key placement, inventory health, and network performance metrics.
   

  

 ∙ SQL and data engineering: Write efficient, production\-grade SQL on large datasets (Redshift, Hive, Athena). Build and maintain ETL pipelines, data marts, and reusable datasets that scale across the team.
   

  

 ∙ Problem identification: Proactively find gaps, anomalies, and improvement opportunities in placement logic, replenishment patterns, and inventory positioning — often before stakeholders ask. Frame these as business problems with quantified impact.
   

  

 ∙ Drive business decisions: Partner with Program Managers and Category teams to size opportunities, run A/B tests or controlled experiments, and recommend changes to placement strategy, sourcing policies, or network design.
   

  

 ∙ Goal and metric ownership: Own the definition, tracking, and reporting of team\-level metrics and weekly/monthly business reviews (WBR/MBR). Investigate variances and root\-cause performance misses.
   

  

 ∙ Stakeholder communication: Present findings to senior leadership in crisp, data\-backed narratives — both written documents and verbal reviews. Influence decisions without authority.
   

  

 ∙ Tooling and automation: Identify manual, repetitive workflows and automate them using SQL, Python, or scripting. Continuously raise the bar on team productivity.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 1\+ years of data analytics or automation experience
* 1\+ years of capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of data pipelining and extraction using SQL
* Knowledge of SQL and Excel at a moderate or advanced level
* Experience with data mining tools like SQL, SAS, SPSS, or similar


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics, or a related quantitative field

title: Business Analyst
description:
**About The Role**
**We are looking for a Business Analyst** 
 who can operate with
 **high ownership, independence, and leadership** 
 in enterprise\-scale projects. This role goes beyond documentation — the ideal candidate will
 **drive requirement clarity, challenge assumptions, lead discussions** 
 , and act as the
 **primary requirement authority** 
 for the delivery team.
   

  

 You will work closely with clients, product owners, architects, developers, QA, and PMs, but you are
 **not expected to ALWAYS rely on PMs for direction** 
 . You should be comfortable taking charge of requirement discovery, refinement, and scope control from day one.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Requirement Ownership \& Analysis**
* Lead end\-to\-end requirement discovery for enterprise\-level applications involving complex workflows and multiple stakeholders.
* Analyze business needs, identify gaps, dependencies, risks, and edge cases early.
* Convert ambiguous inputs into clear, actionable requirements without waiting for direction.


**Documentation \& Artifacts**
* Create and maintain:
* Business Requirement Documents (BRD)
* Functional Requirement Documents (FRD)
* User stories, use cases, and process flows
* Produce low\-fidelity artifacts (wireframes, flow diagrams, mockups) to freeze scope early and avoid downstream ambiguity.
* Maintain traceability between requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and test scenarios.


**JIRA \& Backlog Leadership**
* Own backlog creation and refinement in JIRA.
* Write high\-quality user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
* Structure backlog using appropriate issue types (Epic, Story, Task, Bug, Change Request).
* Perform story slicing (vertical \& horizontal) to support incremental delivery.
* Ensure backlog readiness by enforcing Definition of Ready (DoR).


**Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* Act as Level\-1 functional authority for developers, QA, UX, and other cross\-functional teams.
* Lead refinement and requirement walkthrough sessions confidently.
* Clarify requirements proactively by routing through the PM.
* Challenge solutions when they do not meet business intent.


**UAT \& Delivery Support**
* Drive UAT planning, execution support, and feedback consolidation.
* Ensure business feedback is translated into clear actions and resolved before go\-live.
* Validate delivered solutions against original business intent.


**Must\-Have Skills \& Experience**
* 3–5\+ years of experience as a Business Analyst on enterprise\-scale projects
* Strong hands\-on expertise in:
* JIRA (advanced usage, not basic ticketing)
* User story writing \& acceptance criteria
* BRD, FRD, and functional documentation
* Ability to work independently and lead without ALWAYS relying on PM instructions
* Strong understanding of Agile / Scrum ceremonies and delivery flow
* Proven experience working directly with clients and senior stakeholders
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills (English)
* Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail and big\-picture thinking


**Good to Have / Added Advantage**
* Experience creating low\-fidelity wireframes or process flows (Figma, Lucid, Draw.io, etc.)
* Strong experience using JIRA and Confluence for documentation, decision logs, and requirement tracking
* Exposure to compliance\-heavy or regulated domains
* Ability to mentor junior BAs or guide team members on requirement best practices


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, or a related field
* Relevant certifications such as CBAP, CCBA, or equivalent (preferred, not mandatory)


**What Success Looks Like In This Role**
* Delivery teams clearly understand what to build and why without repeated clarifications
* Minimal requirement churn during development
* High\-quality backlog that enables predictable delivery
* Stakeholders trust you as the single source of truth for requirements
* PMs see you as a partner, not someone they need to micro\-manage

* Hands\-on experience with Vue.js/Vue 3 or a similar component\-based framework, Vue 3 experience is preferred
* Familiarity with frontend state management and routing patterns such as Pinia, Vuex, and Vue Router
* API\-driven development experience working with REST APIs, JSON payloads, WebSocket updates, and asynchronous data flows
* Experience with frontend build tooling such as Webpack, npm, TypeScript, Babel, and related configuration
* Familiarity with testing frameworks and tools such as Jest, Vue Test Utils, jsdom, Playwright, or Puppeteer
* Exposure to browser extension development, browser APIs, DOM instrumentation, or cross\-browser debugging is strongly preferred
* Understanding of accessibility, security, performance, and cross\-browser compatibility considerations in frontend applications
* Experience with version control and collaborative development workflows using GitHub or GitLab



**Personal Attributes:** 



* Strong communication, analytical, and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to write clean, modular, testable, and maintainable code
* Ownership mindset with attention to detail and willingness to debug complex product behavior
* Collaborative approach and comfort working with cross\-functional Agile/Scrum teams
* Curiosity for testing, browser automation, user experience, and modern frontend technologies

title: Frontend Developer – Medical Imaging
description:
Frontend Developer – Medical Imaging (DICOM , OHIF , PACS)
   

  

**Job Description**
 At NeuroDiscovery AI, we have solved the neurology recruitment crisis, unlocked comprehensive real\-world data access, and accelerated real\-world evidence generation. While competitors take 6–18 months to fill trials, we deliver qualified patients in weeks, instant real\-world data access, and actionable evidence in days through our proprietary NeuroLLM trained on 5M\+ patient records with 1\.5M\+ active patients.
   

  

 NeuroDiscovery AI is seeking a Frontend Developer with deep, hands\-on experience in medical imaging technology—specifically DICOM, OHIF, Orthanc, and PACS integrations. This is not a general frontend role; we are exclusively looking for engineers who have previously built, customized, or integrated clinical imaging viewers or PACS systems. You will play a critical role in building next\-generation imaging interfaces that power neurological AI workflows, multimodal research, and patient analytics at scale.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, test, and deploy user interfaces for advanced medical imaging platforms using modern web technologies (React.js, Next.js, JavaScript,TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3\).
* Customize, extend, and optimize DICOM imaging viewers such as OHIF Viewer or CornerstoneJS for visualization, manipulation, and interpretation workflows.
* Integrate Orthanc or other PACS servers to support secure retrieval, streaming, and querying of imaging studies.
* Implement and optimize LLM\-powered features within the imaging viewer — such as natural language search, study summarization, annotation extraction, and intelligent workflow assistance.
* Build responsive, accessible, and intuitive web applications that support the review and manipulation of DICOM and multimodality medical images.
* Integrate frontend applications with backend services and PACS systems via RESTful APIs, ensuring secure and reliable data exchange.
* Collaborate with UI,UX designers, clinicians, AI engineers, and backend teams to translate imaging requirements into technical solutions.
* Optimize frontend applications for speed, scalability, streaming performance, and cross\-browser,device compatibility.
* Conduct code reviews, write unit and integration tests, and maintain high code quality standards.
* Stay current with emerging imaging, PACS, and frontend technologies.
* Document architecture, imaging workflows, technical design decisions, and APIs, and contribute to internal knowledge sharing.
* Participate in Agile team ceremonies and engineering processes.


**Minimum Qualifications**
 Important: Only candidates with real\-world DICOM,OHIF,Orthanc,PACS experience will be considered. Please do not apply without this background.
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
* 3\+ years of frontend development experience with direct expertise in healthcare imaging systems.
* Strong, hands\-on experience working with DICOM image formats and PACS servers (Orthanc, dcm4chee, or equivalent).
* Practical experience customizing or integrating OHIF Viewer, CornerstoneJS, or similar medical imaging frameworks.
* Proficient in JavaScript frameworks,libraries such as Next.js, React.js, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and responsive web design principles.
* Familiarity with frontend testing frameworks and CI,CD pipelines.
* Understanding of healthcare standards and data privacy regulations (HIPAA, GDPR).
* Proficiency in Git and modern development tools.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and communication capabilities.


**Critical Skills**
* Hands\-on experience with OHIF Viewer, CornerstoneJS, Orthanc, PACS integrations, and clinical imaging workflows.
* Strong frontend architecture design and modular component development skills.
* Experience integrating frontend applications with REST APIs and backend imaging services.
* Knowledge of healthcare software security best practices.
* Experience with cloud platforms, Docker, or containerized deployments is a plus.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced, high\-performance environment.


**Additional Knowledge \& Skills**
* Familiarity with healthcare standards such as HL7 and FHIR is beneficial.
* Background in AI,ML\-assisted imaging tools, neuroimaging, or clinical research platforms is a plus.
* Experience with frontend performance optimization and accessibility compliance.
* Strong attention to detail and a passion for building world\-class user experiences.


**Our Stack**
 React.js, Next.js, JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, CSS3, DICOM viewers (OHIF Viewer, CornerstoneJS), Orthanc PACS integrations, REST APIs, Git, Docker, Cloud Platforms.
   

  

**Why NeuroDiscovery AI?**
 As part of NeuroDiscovery AI, you will shape innovative solutions that meaningfully advance neurological research and patient care. We offer competitive compensation, flexible work arrangements, and a culture focused on impact and growth.
   

  

**Benefits At NeuroDiscovery AI**
* Higher\-than\-industry salary packages to reward top talent.
* Collaborate with leading experts across AI, product, imaging, and research.
* Flexible remote work setup.
* Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family.
* Generous stock option plan.
* Access to premium learning resources.

title: JavaScript Engineer
description:
As an hourly paid, fully remote JavaScript Engineer for AI Data Training, you will review complex AI\-generated code and explanations or generate new ones, evaluate the reasoning quality and step\-by\-step problem\-solving, and provide expert feedback that helps models produce answers that are accurate, logical, and clearly explained. You will assess solutions for accuracy, clarity, and adherence to the prompt, identify errors in methodology or conceptual understanding, fact\-check information, write high\-quality explanations and model solutions that demonstrate correct methods, and rate and compare multiple AI responses based on correctness and reasoning quality. This role is with SME Careers, a fast\-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate that provides AI training data for many of the world’s largest AI companies and foundation model labs. Your work will directly help improve the world’s premier AI models while giving you the flexibility of impactful, detail\-oriented remote contract work.
   

  

**Important**
 There is no immediate project for this role; however, if qualified, you will be among the first experts we reach out to when relevant opportunities arise. This will also provide you with access to future projects available through our expert network.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop AI Training Content: Create detailed prompts in various topics and responses to guide AI learning, ensuring the models reflect a comprehensive understanding of diverse subjects.
* Optimize AI Performance: Evaluate and rank AI responses to enhance the model's accuracy, fluency, and contextual relevance.
* Ensure Model Integrity: Test AI models for potential inaccuracies or biases, validating their reliability across use cases.


**Your Profile**
* Minimum 2\+ years of professional JavaScript experience in production environments.
* Strong understanding of closures, async/await, prototype\-based inheritance, and JavaScript event loop behavior, with deep proficiency in modern Vanilla JavaScript (ES6/ES2015\+).
* Proven ability to evaluate correctness, readability, and performance of JavaScript code, including identifying subtle logic and edge\-case issues.
* Hands\-on work experience in software engineering, preferably in roles involving code review, mentoring, or technical design discussions.
* Significant experience using LLMs or AI coding assistants while programming, combined with a critical mindset for validating their output.
* Excellent English writing skills, capable of producing clear, concise, and pedagogical technical explanations.
* Strong proficiency with at least one major frontend framework (such as React, Angular, or Vue.js) or backend runtime (such as Node.js with Express or NestJS).
* Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a closely related technical field.
* Previous experience with AI data training, data annotation, or evaluation of AI\-generated technical content is a strong plus; Minimum C1 English proficiency and a highly detail\-oriented working style are required.
* Preferred: contributions or merged PRs in JavaScript or TypeScript open\-source projects, familiarity with bundlers and tooling (Webpack, Vite, Rollup), frontend–backend integration and Node.js runtime behavior, reviewing typed API layers, DTOs, or schema\-driven designs, and experience evaluating frontend logic, async patterns, and state management.

Job Summary

We are looking for an HR Executive to support both recruitment and HR operations. The ideal candidate will be responsible for coordinating hiring activities, managing employee records, supporting onboarding and offboarding processes, and ensuring smooth day\-to\-day HR operations.

* Source candidates through job portals, social media, and referrals.
* Screen resumes and shortlist suitable candidates.
* Schedule and coordinate interviews with hiring managers.
* Follow up with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
* Pre\-joining formalities.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and hiring reports.

HR Operations

* Support onboarding and employee orientation activities.
* Maintain employee records and HR documentation.
* Assist in attendance and leave management.
* Handle employee queries related to HR policies and processes.
* Ensure HR records are updated in HRMS systems.

Required Skills

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Basic knowledge of recruitment and HR operations.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and Google Sheets.
* Strong organizational and coordination skills.
* Attention to detail and ability to maintain confidentiality.

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**Job Overview**  
We are seeking a dynamic and strategic Human Resources Executive to lead our HR initiatives and foster a thriving organizational culture. In this pivotal role, you will drive talent acquisition, employee relations, performance management, and organizational development. Your expertise will shape our HR strategies, ensuring compliance with employment laws and fostering a positive, productive workplace environment. This position offers an exciting opportunity to influence company growth through innovative HR practices and strategic planning.

**Duties**

* Develop and implement comprehensive talent acquisition strategies to attract top talent across various departments.
* Oversee employee onboarding, orientation programs, and ongoing training \& development initiatives to enhance workforce capabilities.
* Manage employee relations by addressing conflicts, conducting performance evaluations, and facilitating effective communication between staff and leadership.
* Ensure compliance with employment \& labor law, OSHA regulations, workers' compensation policies, and other legal requirements.
* Administer benefits programs, payroll systems such as Workday or ADP, and HRIS platforms like SAP SuccessFactors or Oracle HCM to streamline HR operations.
* Lead succession planning efforts and support senior leadership in organizational design and change management processes.
* Implement process improvements in HR sourcing, program management, and data analysis to optimize efficiency and effectiveness.

**Skills**

* Extensive knowledge of employment \& labor law, OSHA standards, workers' compensation procedures, and benefits administration.
* Proven experience in talent acquisition, recruiting strategies, and HR sourcing techniques using ATS systems such as Taleo or Paylocity.
* Strong negotiation skills paired with excellent communication skills to manage contracts, employee evaluations, and conflict resolution.
* Demonstrated supervising experience with the ability to lead HR teams effectively while collaborating with senior leadership.
* Proficiency in HRIS platforms including UltiPro, Kronos, Ceridian, or Dayforce; expertise in data collection and analysis for strategic decision\-making.
* Skilled in organizational design, performance management systems, training \& development programs, and process improvement initiatives.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities efficiently within a fast\-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail. Join us as a Human Resources Executive and become a vital part of shaping our company's future! Your strategic insight and energetic approach will empower our workforce and drive organizational success through innovative HR solutions.

Work Location: In person

title: General Manager – Operations (SaaS, ERP, CRM & POS Software)
description:
**Company:** KOKA Software Technology Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu (On\-site)  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 8\+ Years  
**Industry:** SaaS, ERP, CRM, POS Software

About Us

KOKA Software Technology Pvt. Ltd. is a growing software company specializing in ERP, CRM, POS, Accounting, Inventory Management, and Business Automation solutions. We serve customers across multiple industries and are expanding our SaaS business in India and international markets.

We are seeking a highly capable General Manager – Operations to oversee and manage the company's day\-to\-day operations, ensuring smooth execution across Development, Customer Support, Sales, Marketing, HR, and Administration.

Role Summary

The General Manager – Operations will be responsible for driving operational excellence, team performance, process implementation, customer satisfaction, and overall business execution. This role reports directly to the Managing Director and will act as the central point of coordination across all departments.

Key ResponsibilitiesOperations Management

* Oversee daily business operations across all departments.
* Ensure smooth coordination between Development, Support, Sales, Marketing, HR, and Finance teams.
* Develop and implement operational policies, SOPs, and performance standards.
* Monitor organizational productivity and efficiency.

Team Leadership

* Lead and mentor department heads and team members.
* Conduct weekly and monthly review meetings.
* Track employee KPIs and departmental performance.
* Foster a high\-performance and accountability\-driven culture.

Customer Success \& Service Delivery

* Ensure timely resolution of customer issues and escalations.
* Monitor customer satisfaction and retention metrics.
* Improve service delivery processes and support operations.

Project \& Product Delivery

* Monitor software development and implementation timelines.
* Coordinate with project teams to ensure on\-time delivery.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement corrective actions.

Business Performance

* Track revenue, operational costs, and business performance metrics.
* Prepare management reports and dashboards.
* Support business expansion initiatives and process improvements.

HR \& Administration

* Coordinate recruitment, onboarding, and employee performance reviews.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.
* Support workforce planning and organizational development.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Management, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* MBA is preferred.
* Minimum 8 years of operational management experience.
* At least 3 years in a leadership role managing multiple departments.
* Experience in SaaS, Software, ERP, CRM, POS, or IT Services industries preferred.
* Strong leadership, communication, and decision\-making skills.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Experience with KPI management and performance tracking.

Preferred Experience

* Managing software development and support teams.
* SaaS business operations.
* Customer success and service management.
* Process improvement and organizational scaling.
* ERP, CRM, POS, or enterprise software environments

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Departmental KPI Achievement
* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
* Customer Retention Rate
* Project Delivery Timeliness
* Support Ticket Resolution Performance
* Employee Productivity and Retention
* Revenue Growth Support
* Process Compliance and Operational Efficiency

What We Offer

* Leadership role with direct access to senior management.
* Opportunity to build and scale a growing software company.
* Career growth into Director of Operations or COO role.
* Performance\-based incentives.
* Dynamic and collaborative work environment.

How to Apply

Submit your updated resume along with a brief summary of your operational leadership experience, including team size managed, departments overseen, and notable achievements in improving business performance.

**Position:** General Manager – Operations  
**Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu  
**Company:** KOKA Software Technology Pvt. Ltd.

 **Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.

title: Special Education Teacher
company: prayaas therapy and child development center
description:
1\. Special Educator (Special Education Teacher)

Purpose of Role: To provide tailored academic and developmental support to students with diverse learning needs, ensuring they meet their educational potential through individualized instruction.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a dedicated Special Educator to join our team. You will be responsible for assessing student needs, developing Individualized Education Plans (IEPs), and adapting the general curriculum to accommodate various learning disabilities (including Autism, ADHD, Dyslexia, and other developmental delays). You will work closely with parents, general education teachers, and therapists to create a supportive learning environment.

Key Responsibilities:

\* Assessment \& Planning: Assess students’ skills to determine their needs and develop Individualized Education Plans (IEPs) with specific, measurable goals.

\* Instruction: Plan, organize, and assign activities that are specific to each student’s abilities; teach socially acceptable behavior and daily living skills.

\* Curriculum Adaptation: Modify the general education curriculum for special\-needs students based upon a variety of instructional techniques and technologies.

\* Collaboration: Meet with parents, counselors, and administrators to discuss student progress; co\-teach with regular education teachers to support inclusion.

\* Documentation: Maintain accurate and complete student records, progress reports, and compliance with all state/federal regulations.

Qualifications:

\* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Special Education.

\* Valid State/National Special Education Teaching License/Certification.

\* Experience working with children/adults with special needs (specific diagnosis experience can be specified here, e.g., ASD).

\* Knowledge of IEP development and special education laws (e.g., IDEA).

2\. Speech Therapist (Speech\-Language Pathologist)

Purpose of Role: To diagnose and treat individuals with speech, language, voice, fluency, and swallowing disorders, helping them communicate effectively.

Job Summary:

We are hiring a compassionate and skilled Speech\-Language Pathologist (SLP). You will evaluate and treat clients with communication disorders, ranging from articulation and fluency issues to complex language processing disorders. You will work within a multidisciplinary team to help clients achieve functional communication goals.

Key Responsibilities:

\* Evaluation: Conduct comprehensive screenings and assessments to identify speech, language, and swallowing disorders.

\* Treatment Planning: Create and implement individualized treatment plans tailored to the specific needs of the client (e.g., articulation therapy, language intervention, dysphagia management).

\* Therapy Delivery: Provide individual or group therapy sessions using evidence\-based techniques and therapeutic tools (including AAC devices where necessary).

\* Family Education: Counsel and train family members and caregivers on how to support the client’s communication development at home.

\* Collaboration: Consult with teachers, special educators, and other therapists to integrate speech goals into the client's daily routine.

Qualifications:

\* Master’s degree in Speech\-Language Pathology.

\* Valid State License and ASHA Certification (CCC\-SLP) or equivalent national certification.

\* Experience with pediatric or adult populations (depending on your facility's focus).

\* Proficiency in using Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) devices is a plus.

3\. Occupational Therapist (OT)

Purpose of Role: To help individuals develop, recover, and improve the skills needed for daily living and working, focusing on physical, sensory, and cognitive independence.

Job Summary:

We are looking for an Occupational Therapist to help our clients participate fully in their daily lives. You will work with individuals who have conditions that are mentally, physically, developmentally, or emotionally disabling. Your focus will be on "occupations" of daily life—from self\-care (dressing, eating) to school performance (handwriting, focus) and play.

Key Responsibilities:

\* Evaluation: Assess clients’ physical, sensory, and cognitive abilities to determine their functional levels and barriers to independence.

\* Intervention: Develop therapeutic programs to improve fine motor skills, sensory processing, hand\-eye coordination, and daily living skills (ADLs).

\* Sensory Integration: Design and implement sensory diets and environmental modifications to help clients regulate their sensory systems.

\* Equipment Recommendation: Advise on and teach the use of adaptive equipment (e.g., pencil grips, wheelchairs, sensory aids) to replace lost function.

\* Documentation \& Review: Regularly evaluate progress, modifying treatment plans as necessary, and maintain precise clinical documentation.

Qualifications:

\* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Occupational Therapy.

\* Valid State License and National Board Certification (NBCOT).

\* Strong background in Sensory Integration (SI) therapy is often highly valued.

\* Ability to lift and move clients/equipment as needed.

Quick Comparison for Hiring Managers

If you are hiring for a center, it is helpful to know the distinct "lane" for each professional to avoid role confusion:

\| Role \| Primary Focus \| Key Outcome \|

\|\-\-\-\|\-\-\-\|\-\-\-\|

\| Special Educator \| Academics \& Behavior \| The student can access the curriculum and learn in a classroom setting. \|

\| Speech Therapist \| Communication \& Swallowing \| The client can speak, understand language, and express needs clearly. \|

\| Occupational Therapist \| Daily Function \& Motor Skills \| The client can independently perform tasks like writing, dressing, and playing. \|

**About the Company**

Miracles is a technology\-driven proprietary trading and research firm building scalable, high\-performance quantitative trading systems. We operate across Indian financial markets including NSE, BSE, and MCX, with a strong emphasis on data\-driven research, innovation, and systematic trading.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a **Quantitative Researcher (Fresher)** to join our growing research team. This role is ideal for graduates with strong foundations in mathematics, statistics, and programming who are eager to apply their analytical skills to real\-world financial markets.

You will work closely with senior researchers and contribute to strategy research, data analysis, backtesting, and real\-time model validation across NSE, BSE, and MCX markets.

Key Responsibilities

* Clean, preprocess, and structure historical and real\-time market data (tick\-level and OHLC) using Python, Pandas, and NumPy for quantitative research.

* Build and maintain dashboards and visualization tools using Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Zoho Analytics to track strategy performance and market behavior.
* Monitor live data streams and validate real\-time strategy outputs against backtested results; handle forward\-fill logic, missing ticks, and data irregularities using Python.
* Collaborate with senior researchers, developers, and trading teams to support research initiatives and contribute to idea generation.

**Required Skills \& Tools**

* Python (mandatory) — primary language for all data and research tasks
* Pandas — data manipulation, cleaning, and time\-series handling
* NumPy — numerical computation and array operations
* Matplotlib — charting and strategy performance visualization
* Seaborn — statistical data visualization

**Tools \& Platforms**

* Jupyter Notebook / Google Colab — research and prototyping environment
* Statistical Analysis — probability, z\-score, correlation, hypothesis testing
* Machine Learning — basic ML concepts applied to market data modelling
* Analytical Reasoning — pattern recognition and systematic thinking

**Education**

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in one of the following:

* Mathematics
* Statistics / Applied Statistics
* Physics

**What You Will Learn**

* Real\-world quant trading systems — not theoretical
* Working with tick\-level data and live trading environments
* Full strategy lifecycle: idea → backtest → validation → live deployment
* NSE / BSE / MCX market microstructure, options \& derivatives

**Preferred Traits**

* Strong analytical thinking and curiosity to explore data
* Ability to learn quickly and adapt in a fast\-paced research environment
* Attention to detail and methodical problem\-solving approach
* Interest in financial markets and systematic trading
